title: Evidence snapshot (frozen before evaluation; never amended after)

order.description: Acquisition order, exactly 0..n-1 across items in array order. Evidence after the freeze never enters this decision.

acquired_at.description: Must be at or before frozen_at.

value.description: No floats. Non-integer numbers are canonical decimal strings per spec/canonicalization.md.

value_digest.description: Digest of this item's value. Present only when value is present.

snapshot_digest.description: Digest of this snapshot with snapshot_digest omitted, per spec/canonicalization.md.
